title: Reward Hacking Detection Under Multi-Step vs Single-Step Tasks: Does Complexity Help Monitors?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Determines whether longer agentic tasks are easier or harder to monitor. If monitoring improves with task length, giving agents more autonomy actually helps safety. A counterintuitive finding would reshape threat models.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Stratifying existing MALT data by step count and applying prompted monitors. No new data generation or model training. API-based. Straightforward data analysis. Very accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three strata by step count, one monitor, AUROC per stratum. Pure analysis of existing data. Minimal setup. Well within 30 hours.
